data.name: Miiridian Prime
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of Miiridian Prime, a free-to-play, class-based third-person PvP battle arena set in a striking science-fantasy universe. Every hero is unique, with their own class, abilities, and combat style, and victory belongs only to those who adapt, master their playstyle, and outthink their rivals.

EARLY ACCESS BETA

This is the Early Access Beta version of Miiridian Prime — an evolving experience where your feedback and participation will help shape the future of the game. During this phase, players can expect regular updates introducing new heroes, arenas, and gameplay features, as well as ongoing balance adjustments and performance improvements.

Join early, share your insights, and become part of the community defining what Miiridian Prime will become.

MASTER THE ART OF HEROES

Miiridian Prime features nine unique heroes, each with their own class, combat style, and set of abilities. No hero is alike — every champion carries a distinct role on the battlefield and a different path to victory.

All heroes wield both melee and ranged weapons, creating powerful combinations for every encounter. Some rely on speed and aggression, others on strategy and battlefield control, while a few stand as the unbreakable shield of their team.

With every update, new heroes, abilities, and playstyles will expand the roster — keeping the game fresh and every battle unforgettable.

MOVEMENT AS A WEAPON

Verticality defines combat in Miiridian Prime. The grappling hook changes how you approach every fight — helping you escape danger, close in on distant opponents, seize high ground, or strike from unexpected angles.

True mastery lies not only in combat but also in movement. Those who control space, control the outcome.

CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEFIELD

Miiridian Prime delivers multiple ways to prove your skill:

  • Free-for-all battles with up to 8 players, where survival is the only law.

  • 4v4 team clashes that reward coordination and smart tactics.

  • 1v1 duels — the ultimate showdown, hero against hero, with nowhere to hide.

  • Objective-driven encounters where capturing zones and completing missions under pressure is the key to victory.

Each mode challenges you in different ways, pushing your adaptability and keeping every fight fresh.

EVOLVING ARENAS

Arenas are more than just backdrops — they shape the flow of combat. Collapsing bridges, explosive traps, and shifting terrain demand constant adaptation, turning the battlefield itself into a weapon.

PROGRESSION & STYLE

Forge your legacy with progression and customization:

  • Unlock new heroes and abilities

  • Climb competitive leaderboards

  • Personalize your champions with distinctive skins and cosmetics

Every match brings progress, rewards, and new ways to stand out.

A LIVING, SURREAL WORLD

Miiridian Prime blends surreal beauty with impossible architecture:

  • Floating islands and ancient ruins steeped in mystery

  • Striking visuals and reactive effects that bring combat to life

  • A hybrid electronic-orchestral soundtrack that intensifies the action

  • Impactful sound design that makes every clash feel real

JOIN THE FIGHT

Miiridian Prime is constantly evolving, with new heroes, arenas, and features added regularly. Step into the surreal battlefield, master your class, and claim your place among legends.

data.short_description: Miiridian Prime is a free-to-play class-based third-person PvP arena where nine unique heroes battle across surreal arenas, combining melee and ranged combat, vertical movement, and team strategy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 7700k / AMD Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / GeForce RTX 1070
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 12500k / AMD Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3060
